All 6 SQLAlchemy models exist (managers, survey_templates, survey_questions, invitations, responses, audit_log) with correct fields per spec

stories.title: Authentication System
stories.description: JWT HS256 auth with bcrypt passwords for manager login/refresh/logout
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns {access_token, refresh_token, token_type}
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns HTTP 401
Access token expires in 15 minutes, refresh token expires in 7 days
JWT tokens use HS256 algorithm with JWT_SECRET from env
POST /api/auth/refresh with valid refresh_token returns new access_token
POST /api/auth/refresh with expired/invalid token returns HTTP 401
POST /api/auth/logout clears refresh token (sets cookie MaxAge=0)
GET /api/me with valid Bearer token returns manager {id, email, full_name, is_active}
GET /api/me without token returns HTTP 401
Passwords stored as bcrypt hash with cost=12
Refresh token stored in httpOnly cookie
backend/services/security.py contains create_access_token, create_refresh_token, verify_token, hash_password, verify_password functions
backend/app/api/auth.py implements all 4 auth endpoints

stories.title: Public API - Client Survey Flow
stories.description: Unauthenticated endpoints for clients to load and fill survey via invitation link
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/public/invitations/{id} returns invitation info + questions + existing_responses
GET /api/public/invitations/{id} for nonexistent id returns HTTP 404
GET /api/public/invitations/{id} for deleted invitation returns HTTP 410
First GET on pending invitation sets started_at and status='in_progress'
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/responses accepts multipart audio file + question_id
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/responses returns {response_id, transcription_status: pending}
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/responses on completed invitation returns HTTP 409
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/responses when re-uploading same question_id: deletes old file, updates record, requeues transcription
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/submit verifies all required questions answered
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/submit with missing required answers returns HTTP 400 with list of missing question_ids
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/submit on complete survey sets status='completed', completed_at=now()
POST /api/public/invitations/{id}/submit on already-completed survey returns HTTP 409
Audio file validation: mime type whitelist (audio/webm, audio/mp4, audio/wav, audio/ogg), max size 25MB
Invalid mime type returns HTTP 422

stories.title: Audio Storage & Streaming
stories.description: Atomic file storage for audio uploads, Range-request streaming for playback
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/services/audio_storage.py exists with save_audio(file, invitation_id, response_id, ext) function
Files saved atomically: written to tmp dir first, then os.rename to final path
Final path format: {AUDIO_ROOT}/{year}/{month}/{invitation_id}/{response_id}.{ext}
GET /api/public/responses/{response_id}/audio streams file with correct Content-Type
GET /api/public/responses/{response_id}/audio supports Range requests (HTTP 206)
GET /api/admin/responses/{response_id}/audio requires JWT auth
Disk space check: if free space < 1GB, POST /responses returns HTTP 503
Magic bytes validation on upload: webm starts with 0x1A 0x45, mp4 has ftyp box
Failed DB commit after file save: file is deleted (cleanup on error)
audio_path stored as relative path within AUDIO_ROOT

stories.title: Transcription Worker
stories.description: arq background worker sending audio to Groq Whisper API with retry logic
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/workers/arq_worker.py defines transcribe_response(ctx, response_id) task
Worker sets transcription_status='processing' and increments attempts before calling Groq
Groq API called with model=whisper-large-v3-turbo, language=ru, response_format=verbose_json
On success: transcription text saved, status='done', transcribed_at=now()
HTTP 429 from Groq: retries with exponential backoff respecting Retry-After header
HTTP 5xx from Groq: retries with backoff schedule 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 30min
HTTP 4xx (non-429) from Groq: immediate status='failed', error saved to transcription_error
After 5 failed attempts: status='failed', transcription_error set
ffprobe validation before Groq call: audio < 0.5s → failed 'Запись слишком короткая'
ffprobe validation: audio > 300s → failed 'Запись превышает максимальную длительность'
ffprobe not found: log WARNING and skip validation (graceful degradation)
asyncio.Semaphore(3) limits concurrent Groq API calls
backend/app/services/transcription.py has TranscriptionService with Groq client
POST /api/admin/responses/{response_id}/retranscribe resets attempts=0, status=pending, enqueues job

stories.title: Manager API
stories.description: Authenticated CRUD for invitations - all managers see all invitations
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/templates returns list of active survey templates
GET /api/templates/{id} returns template with questions ordered by order_index
GET /api/invitations returns paginated list of all non-deleted invitations (all managers see all)
GET /api/invitations supports ?status= filter (pending/in_progress/completed)
GET /api/invitations supports ?search= filter on client_name and client_phone
GET /api/invitations supports ?page= and ?page_size= pagination
GET /api/invitations response includes manager name in each invitation row
GET /api/invitations response includes transcription progress (X ready / Y total) per invitation
POST /api/invitations creates invitation with nanoid(12) id, links to requesting manager
POST /api/invitations returns {id, url} where url={FRONTEND_URL}/s/{id}
GET /api/invitations/{id} returns full invitation: info + questions + responses with audio_url + transcriptions
GET /api/invitations/{id} for deleted invitation returns HTTP 404
DELETE /api/invitations/{id} soft-deletes (sets deleted_at=now()), writes audit_log entry
GET /api/invitations/{id}/export?format=csv_summary returns CSV file download
GET /api/invitations/{id}/export?format=csv_rows returns CSV rows file download
GET /api/invitations/{id}/export?format=xlsx_summary returns XLSX file download
GET /api/invitations/{id}/export?format=xlsx_rows returns XLSX file download
GET /api/invitations/{id}/export?format=pdf returns PDF file download
GET /api/invitations/export?format=csv_summary returns HTTP 501 Not Implemented
Audit log entries written for: create_invitation, delete_invitation, export, login

stories.title: Export Service
stories.description: CSV, XLSX (summary + rows formats), and PDF export of survey responses
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/services/export.py exists with generate_csv_summary, generate_csv_rows, generate_xlsx_summary, generate_xlsx_rows, generate_pdf functions
CSV summary: one row per invitation, columns: ID, Клиент, Телефон, Менеджер, Статус, Создано, Заполнено, Вопрос 1..N
CSV rows: one row per answer, columns: ID приглашения, Клиент, Телефон, Номер вопроса, Текст вопроса, Транскрипция, Длительность сек, Дата записи
XLSX summary uses openpyxl, same structure as CSV summary, auto-column widths
XLSX rows uses openpyxl, same structure as CSV rows
PDF uses weasyprint with HTML template: header with client info, question/answer blocks
All exports return StreamingResponse with correct Content-Disposition filename
Empty transcription cells shown as empty string (not None/null)
